no_tech_support.action: Offer 3-month free trial of Tech Support
no_tech_support.description: Customer has no Tech Support subscription. A free trial reduces friction and increases service stickiness.

no_online_security.action: Offer 3-month free trial of Online Security
no_online_security.description: Customer lacks online security. Adding this protective service increases switching cost and perceived value.

no_device_protection.action: Offer free Device Protection for 6 months
no_device_protection.description: No device protection plan. Protecting their device creates a tangible benefit that discourages switching.

no_online_backup.action: Offer free Online Backup for 3 months
no_online_backup.description: Adding backup service creates data lock-in.

month_to_month.action: Offer 15% discount for annual contract upgrade
month_to_month.description: Month-to-month contract is the #1 churn predictor. Incentivize commitment with a meaningful discount.

high_risk_contract.action: Priority: Bundle discount (annual contract + security + support)
high_risk_contract.description: High-risk customer: month-to-month + no security + no support. Offer a comprehensive bundle at 20% discount.

payment_friction.description: Electronic check + paperless billing = high friction. Autopay reduces involuntary churn and improves experience.

high_charges.action: Offer loyalty discount or usage-based plan migration
high_charges.description: Monthly charges are high relative to tenure/services. A 10% loyalty discount or right-sized plan reduces bill shock.

usage_decline.description: Usage is declining — this often precedes churn by 2-3 months. Proactive outreach with bonus data/minutes can reverse the trend.

high_support_calls.action: Assign dedicated support rep + satisfaction follow-up
high_support_calls.description: High support ticket volume indicates frustration. Dedicated support resolves issues faster and shows care.

network_quality.description: High dropped call rate indicates network issues in their area. Investigate and offer a service credit while resolving.

retention_call.action: Immediate warm transfer to retention specialist + best available offer
retention_call.description: Customer has already called the retention team — they are actively considering leaving. Escalate immediately.

general_churn_risk.description: General churn risk without a clear single driver. A personal call acknowledging their loyalty can help.
